item.title: Whiskers 0.8.58
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.58

### Free Tier

  • Increased the free plan to 2,000 words per week to match the current offer
  • Removed the daily free-tier cap so occasional longer dictation days are less likely to get blocked

    • ### Reliability

  • Improved dictation stability and memory usage so longer recording and transcription sessions stay more dependable
  • Improved text insertion and dictation finalization so completed transcripts are less likely to get lost at the end of a session
  • Improved cloud transcription reliability with stronger request handling and safer network boundaries

    • ### Setup & Controls

  • Improved shortcut configuration so recording controls are easier to set up and behave more consistently
  • Improved cloud transcription setup and model selection so provider configuration is easier to manage in Settings

    • ### AI Enhancement

  • Improved Screen Awareness context so AI-enhanced dictation can better preserve file names, code symbols, and other on-screen terms
